newsitem.title: FRANCE: VW says eight-month sales up 12.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: VW says eight-month sales up 12.7 percent.

text.p: German carmaker Volkswagen AG said on Tuesday its sales for the first eight months of 1996 increased 12.7 percent to 2.66 million vehicles and that it still expected record 1996 sales.
"We will reach this year a new record in terms of vehicle sales," VW management board member Robert Buechelhofer told Reuters at the Paris car show.
Buechelhofer said vehicle deliveries in western Europe, including Germany, were up 11.3 percent, while German vehicle sales grew 3.1 percent.
In the North American market, including Mexico, Buechelhofer said vehicle sales to customers were up 14.7 percent while sales in Asia increased by about 22 percent.
